description: This file implements threading functionalities including thread management, mutexes, conditions, and asynchronous operations for the Wesnoth project, utilizing SDL library functions.

classes.name: manager
classes.description: Manages thread cleanup by waiting for detached threads to finish upon destruction.

classes.name: thread
classes.description: Encapsulates SDL thread creation, joining, killing, and detaching.

classes.name: mutex
classes.description: Wraps SDL mutex creation and destruction.

classes.name: lock
classes.description: RAII lock for mutex, managing lock acquisition and release.

classes.name: condition
classes.description: Wraps SDL condition variable functionalities including wait, notify, and timeout.

classes.name: async_operation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous operation with execution, notification, and completion handling.

methods.name: run_async_operation
methods.description: Function executed in a separate thread to run an async operation and handle its lifecycle.

methods.name: manager::~manager
methods.description: Destructor that waits for all detached threads to complete.

methods.name: thread::thread
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new SDL thread with a given function and data.

methods.name: thread::~thread
methods.description: Destructor that joins the thread if still running.

methods.name: thread::kill
methods.description: Kills the thread if it is running.

methods.name: thread::join
methods.description: Waits for the thread to finish execution.

methods.name: thread::detach
methods.description: Detaches the thread, allowing it to run independently.

methods.name: condition::wait_timeout
methods.description: Waits with a timeout on the condition variable.

methods.name: condition::notify_one
methods.description: Signals one thread waiting on the condition.

methods.name: condition::notify_all
methods.description: Broadcasts to all threads waiting on the condition.

methods.name: async_operation::notify_finished
methods.description: Marks the async operation as finished and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: async_operation::execute
methods.description: Executes the async operation in a thread, handling completion or abortion.
